sources.title: Tongji University Siping data-centre room works: bidder-ranking notice
sources.publisher: 同济大学采购与招标管理办公室 (Tongji University Procurement and Tendering Office)
sources.source_family: 同济大学采购与招标管理办公室 (Tongji University Procurement and Tendering Office)
sources.attribution: 同济大学采购与招标管理办公室 (Tongji University Procurement and Tendering Office)
sources.summary: Tongji published the ranking of two bidders for its Siping data-centre room works. The first-ranked bidder is Shanghai Beiding Information Technology. This is a candidate notice subject to objections, not a final contract award, development consent or confirmation that fit-out work has begun.
sources.original_title: 四平数据中心机房建设工程采购项目中标候选人公示
sources.date_semantics: Visible publication October14,2026 at17:25. The title and body say candidate ranking even though the site category says award results. Date confirms the announced procurement, not a physical milestone.

sources.title: Tongji Siping data-centre tender identifies East Campus A building, first floor
sources.publisher: 同济大学信息公开网 (Tongji University Information Disclosure)
sources.source_family: 同济大学信息公开网 (Tongji University Information Disclosure)
sources.attribution: 同济大学信息公开网 (Tongji University Information Disclosure)
sources.summary: The proposed works are in the first-floor data-centre room of East Campus Building A at 1230 Siping Road. The scope comprises about 267 m² of machine-room space and 84 m² of electrical and battery rooms, totalling 351 m². It includes room fit-out, IT power busbars and cabling, fire protection and environmental monitoring. The specified 60 days is a planned construction duration.
sources.original_title: 四平数据中心机房建设工程采购项目公开招标公告
sources.date_semantics: Explicit September22 publication retained for project scope and location; October13 was the scheduled bid deadline, not a start date.

sources.title: Tongji University official campus-gate directory: 1230 Siping Road is the East Campus entrance
sources.publisher: 同济大学保卫处 (Tongji University Security Department)
sources.source_family: 同济大学保卫处 (Tongji University Security Department)
sources.attribution: 同济大学保卫处 (Tongji University Security Department)
sources.summary: The university identifies 1230 Siping Road as the East Campus main entrance. Its separate main Siping campus entrance is at 1239 Siping Road. This supports the identity of the named East Campus marker; it does not locate the specific A-building machine room.
sources.original_title: 同济大学校门分布情况
sources.date_semantics: Historical campus-address context, not a 2026 construction observation.

sources.title: Tongji January 2024 cloud-platform report distinguishes Jiading from an existing Siping data centre
sources.publisher: 同济大学信息化办公室 (Tongji University Informatization Office)
sources.source_family: 同济大学信息化办公室 (Tongji University Informatization Office)
sources.attribution: 同济大学信息化办公室 (Tongji University Informatization Office)
sources.summary: The university’s January 2024 report describes a cloud data centre at its Jiading campus and says it provides remote disaster recovery for an existing Siping data centre. It does not identify the older Siping centre’s building or its relationship to the 2026 East Campus A fit-out. The 2026 procurement therefore does not establish Tongji’s first data centre or the opening date of this room.
sources.original_title: 同济校园云平台发布暨戴尔科技教育数字化转型研讨会
sources.date_semantics: January24,2024 publication about January17 cloud-platform launch; historical service context only, not current operation at East Campus A.
sources.capacity_exclusion: All Jiading CPU, memory and storage figures belong to the separate Jiading facility and are not assigned to Siping.

sources.title: Tongji University East Campus, OpenStreetMap way 871639330
sources.summary: Community-mapped polygon named Tongji University East Campus. A representative point inside it locates the parent campus of the proposed room works; it does not identify Building A, its first-floor machine room, an entrance or a surveyed campus boundary.
sources.date_semantics: Map edit timestamp is not a construction observation. Project location is confirmed separately by the September22 university tender.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap changeset 179956824: East Campus polygon edit provenance
